name: Custom Shape 3-Layer Wooden Bundle Magnetic Photo Frame
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, providing durability and a warm decorative appearance.
    - The design features a 3-layer wooden structure, carefully laser-cut to create a dimensional layered frame.
    - Each wooden layer has a 3 mm thickness, ensuring a sturdy yet lightweight construction.
    - The frame integrates built-in disc magnets (Ø 1 cm, thickness 3 mm) placed behind the photo slots to securely hold photos in position.
    - Photos are attached using a magnetic sheet backing, allowing them to easily snap into place.
    - Smooth laser-cut edges provide a clean finish and safe handling.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall Dimensions: 
             +) 5 x 5 in ~ 12.7 x 12.7 cm.
             +) 4 x 8 in ~ 10.16 x 20.32 cm.
    - Photo Size:
             +) Minimum magnetic photo size: 2 cm.
             +) Maximum capacity: up to 6 photos.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Produced using advanced UV printing technology to deliver vibrant colors and crisp details.
    - Layer 1: supports 2-sided printing.
    - Layer 2, Layer 3 & photos: 1-sided printing for decorative design elements.
    - Photos are printed with high-definition detail to preserve clarity and color accuracy.
    - The UV printing process ensures fade resistance and long-lasting visual quality.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative wooden magnetic photo frame that displays multiple memorable photos.
    - Magnetic photo holders allow photos to be easily changed or rearranged without damaging the frame.
    - The layered wooden structure creates a 3D decorative effect, enhancing the visual depth of the design.
    - Perfect for display on desks, shelves, bedside tables, or living room décor areas.
    - A meaningful way to showcase family memories, wedding photos, or special moments.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful keepsake for parents, couples, family members, and loved ones.
    - Ideal for Father’s Day, Mother’s Day, anniversaries, weddings, birthdays, or housewarming gifts.
    - Perfect for anyone who enjoys personalized décor and meaningful memory displays.
    - Combines sentimental value with elegant craftsmanship, making it a memorable decorative gift.🎁

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 3-Layer Wooden Bundle Magnetic Photo Frame

 

PRODUCTION

  • Manufacturer: Made by Printway
  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

 

NOTE:

  • Please allow 0.2-0.3 cm differences due to manual measurement.

Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
